content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education Studies Study organisation Academic calendar Academic calendar: winter semester 2025/26 Re-registration for the next semester Re-registration for the summer semester 2026 only runs until 05.02.2026 .
